#| label: fig-paq-likert
#| fig-alt: "Likert plot of PAQ responses"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy
from soundscapy.constants import PAQ_IDS

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sspy.paq_likert(data[PAQ_IDS], title="Distribution of PAQ responses")
plt.show()
